About this Dashboard:


Measures to demonstrate the historic and projected performance of the people within the business, including the resource demand.


Resource Utilization

The historic and forecast utilization as a percent of available time (by month) for resources, including project time only. Forecast utilization is shown by the likelihood of the activities being closed.


The utilization percentages are showing the level of productivity of the resource pool (employees and contractors/associates). The higher the percent, the higher productivity being achieved.


Forecast utilization is expected to reduce over future time, as the likelihood of new activities/business being closed/won are less certain.


Average Daily Rates by BU

The historic and forecast average daily rate (by month) for resources, grouped by Business Unit / Role / Grade.


The Forecast Day/Hour is shown by Business Unit. The rate includes assignments for both T&M and fixed price commercial models.


Headcount Fluctuation

Current headcount (including employees and contractors/associates). At a headline level, the trend shows whether the employee/contractor base is growing.


Open Assignment Demand

The amount of open resourcing demand per Business Unit, broken down by Role, Grade, Location, and month (in detailed report).


Assuming that any available capacity has been resourced against the demand, where possible, the residual demand requires attention in order to fulfill.
